meta.source: Hellemans, S. et al. (2024) Genomic data provide insights into the classification of extant termites. Nature Communications 15: 6724.
meta.corroboration: Song, N., Ji, J. & Su, L. (2026) Phylogeny of termites inferred from mitogenomic data with a large taxon sampling. Genes 17: 1310. 13 科 + 7 种 Cryptocercus 外群，3 套线粒体矩阵（PCG_AA / PCG_NT123 / PCG_rRNA），UFBoot 10 000。

supportNote.zh: 支持值仅标注原文正文给出数值的节点（UFB = ultrafast bootstrap，LPP = local posterior probability，sCF = site concordance factor）；其余节点标为“单系”，表示该研究所有分析均支持其单系性。
supportNote.en: Support values are shown only for nodes for which the source text reports numbers (UFB = ultrafast bootstrap, LPP = local posterior probability, sCF = site concordance factor); other nodes are marked "monophyletic", meaning all analyses of that study supported their monophyly.

features: Cryptocercidae outgroup added (both source papers sample Cryptocercus)
Song et al. 2026 node-level comparison (UFB AA/NT123/rRNA + verdict)
clade brackets in the left margin

children.note: 外群：隐尾蠊属 Cryptocercus。Song et al. (2026) 在分析中取 7 种 Cryptocercus 作外群；Hellemans et al. (2024) 同样以 Cryptocercus 为姐妹群。
children.note_en: Outgroup: the wood-roach genus Cryptocercus. Song et al. (2026) sampled seven Cryptocercus species as outgroups; Hellemans et al. (2024) also recovered Cryptocercus as the sister group of termites.

children.note: 单型科，仅 Mastotermes darwiniensis；在全部分析中都是最基部的白蚁支系。
children.note_en: Monotypic family (Mastotermes darwiniensis); recovered as the most basal termite lineage in all analyses.

song.note: Mastotermitidae 为其余全部白蚁的姐妹群。
song.note_en: Mastotermitidae is recovered as the sister group of all other termites.

children.note: 含 Stolotermes、Porotermes 两属。
children.note_en: Contains Stolotermes and Porotermes.

children.note: 含 Archotermopsis、Zootermopsis 等。
children.note_en: Contains Archotermopsis, Zootermopsis and allies.

children.note: 单型科，仅 Hodotermopsis。
children.note_en: Monotypic family (Hodotermopsis).

children.note: 含 Hodotermes、Anacanthotermes、Microhodotermes。
children.note_en: Contains Hodotermes, Anacanthotermes and Microhodotermes.

children.note: 图 3 中此节点位于异常区（虚线）。
children.note_en: This node lies in an anomaly zone in Fig. 3 (drawn dashed).

children.note: 远等翅类：Stolotermitidae 为其余三科的姐妹群（Hellemans et al. 2024）。
children.note_en: Teletisoptera: Stolotermitidae is the sister group of the remaining three families (Hellemans et al. 2024).

song.note: Song 2026 支持 (Hodotermopsidae+Stolotermitidae) + (Archotermopsidae+Hodotermitidae)，与 Fig. 3 内部关系不同。

children.note: 低等白蚁中多样性最高的一科（23 属 480 种）。
children.note_en: The most diverse family of lower termites (23 genera, 480 species).

children.note: 单属科（Stylotermes）；其系统位置在不同分子数据集间曾反复变动。
children.note_en: Single genus (Stylotermes); its position has shifted among molecular datasets.

song.note: AA 树中与 Serritermitidae 互为姐妹（UFB 96）；两个核苷酸树中为独立的早期分支（UFB 100）。
song.note_en: Sister to Serritermitidae in the AA tree (UFB 96); an independent early-diverging lineage in both nucleotide trees (UFB 100).

children.note: 含 Serritermes、Glossotermes 两属；与狭义鼻白蚁科互为姐妹群（Fig. 3）。
children.note_en: Contains Serritermes and Glossotermes; sister to Rhinotermitidae s.s. in Fig. 3.

song.note: AA 树中与 Stylotermitidae 姐妹；核苷酸树中与 Termitogetonidae 姐妹。
song.note_en: Sister to Stylotermitidae in the AA tree; sister to Termitogetonidae in the nucleotide trees.

children.note: 狭义鼻白蚁科，仅含 Acorhinotermes、Dolichorhinotermes、Parrhinotermes、Rhinotermes、Schedorhinotermes 5 属。
children.note_en: Rhinotermitidae s.s., restricted to Acorhinotermes, Dolichorhinotermes, Parrhinotermes, Rhinotermes and Schedorhinotermes.

song.note: AA 树中 Rhinotermitidae s.s. 为其余新等翅类的姐妹群，位置与 Fig. 3 不同。
song.note_en: In the AA tree Rhinotermitidae s.s. is sister to the remaining Neoisoptera, unlike Fig. 3.

children.note: 单属科（Termitogeton）；在 Geoisoptera 中的位置不确定（异常区）。
children.note_en: Single genus (Termitogeton); its position within Geoisoptera is uncertain (anomaly zone).

song.note: AA 树中与 Stylotermitidae+Serritermitidae 成支（95）；核苷酸树中与 Serritermitidae 姐妹。
song.note_en: Groups with Stylotermitidae+Serritermitidae in the AA tree (95); sister to Serritermitidae in the nucleotide trees.

children.note: 由 Psammotermitinae + Prorhinotermitinae 提升而来（Psammotermes、Prorhinotermes）；位置在各分析间不稳定。
children.note_en: Raised from Psammotermitinae + Prorhinotermitinae (Psammotermes, Prorhinotermes); placement varies among analyses.

children.note: 含 Coptotermes、Heterotermes、Reticulitermes；Coptotermitinae 并入 Heterotermitinae（后者并系）。
children.note_en: Contains Coptotermes, Heterotermes and Reticulitermes; Coptotermitinae is subsumed in Heterotermitinae (which is paraphyletic).

song.note: Heterotermitidae 与 Termitidae 互为姐妹群。

children.note: 由 Macrotermitinae 中分出（Sphaerotermes sphaerothorax），与 Macrotermitinae 互为姐妹群（Fig. 3）。
children.note_en: Segregated from Macrotermitinae (Sphaerotermes sphaerothorax); sister to Macrotermitinae in Fig. 3.

song.note: Song 2026：Sphaerotermitinae 为独立支系，与 Macrotermitinae 不成姐妹群。
song.note_en: Song 2026 recovers Sphaerotermitinae as a distinct lineage, not sister to Macrotermitinae.

children.note: 与 Sphaerotermitinae 互为姐妹群（Fig. 3；UCE 分析结果相同）。
children.note_en: Sister to Sphaerotermitinae (Fig. 3; also in the UCE analyses).

song.note: Song 2026：Macrotermitinae 是其余白蚁科的姐妹群，而非与 Sphaerotermitinae 互为姐妹。
song.note_en: Song 2026 places Macrotermitinae as sister to all other Termitidae, not as sister to Sphaerotermitinae.

children.note: 含 Foraminitermes、Labritermes 等。
children.note_en: Contains Foraminitermes, Labritermes and allies.

song.note: 两文均识别该支系，但亚科间深层关系未解析。
song.note_en: Recognised in both studies; deep relationships unresolved.

children.note_en: 68 genera, 241 species; monophyletic.

children.note: UFB 100；Onkotermes 的归属仍存不确定性。
children.note_en: UFB 100; the placement of Onkotermes remains uncertain.

children.note: UFB 100；含 Genuotermes（原先暂置于 Termitinae）。
children.note_en: UFB 100; includes Genuotermes (previously placed tentatively in Termitinae).

song.note: 两文均支持单系（Song 2026 将 Genuotermes 并入）。
song.note_en: Monophyletic in both studies (Genuotermes included in Song 2026).

children.note: 单型亚科（Engelitermes zambo）。
children.note_en: Monotypic (Engelitermes zambo).

children.note: 单型亚科（Forficulitermes planifrons）；在部分分析中被识别为 rogue taxon。
children.note_en: Monotypic (Forficulitermes planifrons); identified as a rogue taxon in several analyses.

children.note: 支持度较弱；部分分析未形成此组合。
children.note_en: Weakly supported; this grouping is not recovered in all analyses.

children.note: 单型亚科（Crepititermes verruculosus）；常为 rogue taxon；18/30 个串联分析中与 Cylindrotermitinae + Protohamitermitinae 互为姐妹群（UFB 51–87）。
children.note_en: Monotypic (Crepititermes verruculosus); often a rogue taxon; sister to Cylindrotermitinae + Protohamitermitinae in 18/30 concatenated analyses (UFB 51-87).

children.note: 含 Prohamitermes 等。
children.note_en: Contains Prohamitermes and allies.

children.note: UFB 100。
children.note_en: UFB 100.

children.note: 现存最大的亚科，兵蚁具鼻状额突；UFB 100。
children.note_en: The largest subfamily; soldiers with a nasal fontanelle; UFB 100.

children.note: UFB 100。
children.note_en: UFB 100.

children.note: 狭义白蚁亚科，限于 Termes 及其近缘属；UFB 100。
children.note_en: Termitinae s.s., restricted to Termes and close relatives; UFB 100.

song.note: Song 2026 沿用旧亚科划分并发现 Termitinae 非单系；Hellemans 2024 将其限定为 Termes 及近缘属。
song.note_en: Song 2026 used the traditional subfamily concept and found Termitinae non-monophyletic; Hellemans 2024 restricted it to Termes and allies.

children.note: UFB 100。
children.note_en: UFB 100.

children.note: 12 个亚科级支系构成的未解析多分支（图 3 中以虚线表示）。
children.note_en: An unresolved polytomy of 12 subfamily-level lineages (dashed in Fig. 3).

children.note: 18 个亚科均为单系；亚科之间的深层关系多为极短节间，未完全解析。
children.note_en: All 18 subfamily-level lineages are monophyletic; deep relationships among them are separated by very short internodes and are not fully resolved.

children.note: Fig. 3 中该节点位于异常区（虚线）；Termitogetonidae 与 Psammotermitidae 的位置在各分析间不稳定。
children.note_en: This node lies in an anomaly zone in Fig. 3 (drawn dashed); the positions of Termitogetonidae and Psammotermitidae vary among analyses.

children.note: Geoisoptera 内部顺序为 Fig. 3 首选拓扑，但位于异常区（虚线）。
children.note_en: The internal order of Geoisoptera follows the preferred topology of Fig. 3 but lies in an anomaly zone (drawn dashed).

children.note: 土栖等翅类：6 个科。图 3 中本区内部顺序以虚线（异常区）表示，各分析间不稳定。
children.note_en: Geoisoptera: six families. The internal order follows Fig. 3, but this region is an anomaly zone (dashed) and varies among analyses.

children.note: 新等翅类：7 个科级支系，Stylotermitidae 位于该支系最基部。
children.note_en: Neoisoptera: seven family-level lineages, with Stylotermitidae sister to the rest.

children.note: 近等翅类：Kalotermitidae + Neoisoptera。
children.note_en: Icoisoptera: Kalotermitidae + Neoisoptera.

song.note: Kalotermitidae 与其余新等翅类的关系，与本文一致。
song.note_en: Kalotermitidae as sister to the remaining Neoisoptera, as recovered here.

children.note: 现存等翅下目；分子系统发育研究一致支持白蚁与隐尾蠊属 Cryptocercus 互为姐妹群。
children.note_en: Extant Isoptera; molecular phylogenies consistently place termites as the sister group of the wood-roach genus Cryptocercus.
